definition: Total market value of client assets the bank safekeeps or administers; not the bank's own assets.
why_it_matters: Headline scale metric; basis for servicing fees.

definition: Quantity of one security held in one account as of one business date.
why_it_matters: The grain of the holdings screen and every valuation.

definition: Position quantity times price times FX rate to USD as of the business date.
why_it_matters: Clients reconcile this against their own systems daily.

definition: Lifecycle state of a trade instruction: MATCHED / AFFIRMED / PENDING / SETTLED / FAILED.
why_it_matters: Drives the exceptions screen and fail penalties.

definition: A trade not settled on its intended settlement date because one side was not ready; it is late not cancelled.
why_it_matters: Penalty fines (CSDR in Europe) and client escalations.

definition: Client's same-day confirmation that trade details are correct; US cutoff 21:00 ET on trade date since T+1.
why_it_matters: Late affirmation is the leading indicator of a fail.

definition: (Total assets minus liabilities) divided by shares outstanding for a fund on a valuation date.
why_it_matters: Investors transact at this number; errors above threshold trigger compensation.

definition: The client's instruction on a voluntary corporate action; must arrive before the custodian's client deadline.
why_it_matters: Missed elections are custody's classic multi-million loss.

definition: The custodian's own cutoff for an election; earlier than the market deadline to allow processing.
why_it_matters: The date alerts must escalate towards.

definition: A grant of a permission (VIEW / INSTRUCT / ADMIN) on one account to one user.
why_it_matters: Enforced in every query; a cross-client grant is a security incident.

definition: A user authenticated by the client's own identity provider via SSO rather than credentials issued by the bank.
why_it_matters: Federation shifts credential risk to the client and improves usability.

definition: A notification generated by an event (fail; deadline; NAV delay; cash shortfall) and sent to a user on a channel.
why_it_matters: Volume without acknowledgement is spam; silence is risk.

definition: An alert a user has explicitly actioned in the portal or via API; delivery alone is not acknowledgement.
why_it_matters: The only measure of whether alerting works.

definition: A generated document made visible to entitled users on the portal at published_at.
why_it_matters: Generated is not delivered; published is not read.

definition: Regulatory date before which a document may not be deleted.
why_it_matters: Deleting early is a regulatory breach.

definition: A report executed by a client user directly in the portal or API rather than by the service desk on their behalf.
why_it_matters: The JD's adoption outcome expressed as a number.

definition: Self-service runs divided by all ad-hoc runs (self-service plus service desk) for a period.
why_it_matters: Scorecard metric; target agreed per client.

definition: The promised time by which a data set is available for a business date (e.g. positions by 06:00).
why_it_matters: Clients plan their morning around it; breaches must be visible.
